rules: archive_subtree's frozen threshold is 4 nodes, so any exact fragment that size or larger is burned permanently even when it's only half of an otherwise new expression. Two rejects this round matched an archived member on a single such block (a bare CS_RANK(TS_op(field, window)) or TS_RANK(field_expr, window), shares 4 and shares 5 nodes) while the paired other half was novel.

A dollar_volume-derived rank (ratio, mean, count, or argmax) combined multiplicatively with CS_RANK(TS_SUM($return, N)) failed cheap_screen at N = 5, 10, 21, and 63 this round (|t| 0.11 to 0.94, 4 of 7 cheap_screen rejects). Treat that combinator shape as exhausted rather than resweeping its window.

Both cheap_screen rejects built from $high - $low without dividing by $open or $close scored |t| 0.63 and 0.70. Both accepted range factors this round scaled the range by $open first, so normalize range terms by price before pairing them with volume.

dollar_volume / TS_MEAN($dollar_volume, 126) passed (fitness 0.841) while the same 126-day skeleton normalized by DELAY($dollar_volume, 126) instead failed cheap_screen (|t| 0.63). Favor a smoothed denominator (TS_MEAN or TS_SUM) over a single-day DELAY when ratioing dollar_volume to its own history.

COUNT(threshold-crossing) and TS_ARGMAX on dollar_volume both landed under the cheap_screen bar (|t| 0.64, 0.94) this round. Discretized or index-valued transforms of dollar_volume are carrying less signal than continuous ratio or rank transforms at this stage.
4 of this round's 20 rejects were exact duplicates of another proposal already made in the same run. Check new candidates against the in-run seen set before spending an eval on them.

One crossover call this round failed outright by exceeding the 64000-token output cap, losing that proposal slot with no fitness data at all. Avoid crossing two already-large or deep parents in one call, or cap combined parent size before sending it.

The medium-speed contrast of ABS($return) rank against a dollar_volume TS_RANK scored 2.945, far above this round's slow price-range/volume niche accepts (0.841, 0.328). That return-dispersion-vs-volume-crowding shape at medium speed is the strongest lead to build on next.
